item.title: 【Requests】[REQ PIC] - ALL MADONNA Celebration Cover Variants
item.description:
Good night,

I am specifically looking for one of the 3 variants of Madonna's CELEBRATION (DELUXE) cover.

As you know there are 3 versions:

- Nº1. CD COVER version (which has text on the eyes in the blue area, pink spots at the bottom left and Mr. Brainwash's signature at the bottom right but BIGGER than the other cover nº 2.

- Nº 2. DIGITAL version (It has no text on the blue area of the eyes, nor the pink spots on the bottom right edge. It is a little more enlarged than the previous one leaving less cut the chin and the head of madonna in all its proportion.

- Nº 3. VINYL version (and digital album after 2023.). It is the cover that is easily found right now, at a resolution of 4000x4000 and has the SIGNATURE of Mr. Brainwash in the LOWER LEFT. (It also has no text on the blue part of the eyes).

Well, I'm looking for the cover Nº1 (the one that corresponds to the release of the CD but in a higher quality than I have it. In case you can help me find it, I've been looking for it for weeks and I can't find it.

Thank you very much.

(I attach the 3 covers so you can see which ones they are).
